name: filetree
description: A file tree of what Claude touches: what it is doing now, the files it touched this turn, and which changes are not saved yet (git status)

activity.title: Claude activity
activity.description: Which activity lights up in the tree: files Claude reads (also through search commands such as grep or cat) in blue, files it changes in orange, saving versions and other git work in green

glyphs.title: Icons
glyphs.description: auto: richer icons when a Nerd Font is installed (not in the desktop app); plain: simple symbols only

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: on: the tree scrolls to the file Claude reads, changes or saves. off: the view moves only when you scroll; highlights still show.

column.title: Right column
column.description: What the right column shows by default: date (last change) or size (file size; for folders, the space they take, worked out in the background). The button in the header switches it.
